main_text.head: MINISTERII.
MISERATIONIS. MISERICORDIÆ. COMMISERATIONIS.
main_text.p: PLACULUM est misereri nos hominum rem malè gerentum. Trinc. 2.1. v.13.
NEMINIS misereri certum est: quia mei miseret neminem. Capt. 3.5. v. 107.
Minus id quidem piè dictum est.
Simile vide de mendicis Tit. Egestatis.
main_text.head: MOLESTIÆ. IMPORTUNITATIS.
main_text.p: MOLESTIAM summam creant homines importunè-garru-li: cóque tantùm non enecant. Mil. 4. 2. v. 92.
Sic Græci Θάνατον, sive morbum sibi esse dicunt rem auditu molestam ac tædiosam.
Sophocles; ὦ μοι θάνατος μὴ τάδ' ἀκούειν.

page.notes: Greek in the Sophocles line and "Συμπαθείας" are reproduced from the scan and may contain errors; the Sophocles line is partly illegible. Opening capitals M and P are large initials. Page is otherwise clear.
